about: The kinds of question agents answer by hand to check a web page (mostly through a browser extension or hand-written Playwright screenshot scripts, and curl of a local dev server): does the page load and render, what errors does it throw, is an element there, how does it fit a phone width, what does a click do, and is it safe for red-green colour blindness. Each is put to a public page whose answer is fixed at the time of writing: https://temet-ai.github.io/ask-kit/ (the ask-kit kits page) and https://temet.ai/. The pages are read by a real browser, so a later redesign of either changes an expectation. Local dev servers are left out because their answer depends on the machine.

questions.q: Does https://temet-ai.github.io/ask-kit/ load and render? Give its status and its page title.
Does https://temet.ai/ load without console errors or failed requests? Name any that happen and the file or URL they come from.
Is the text "Reads only" on https://temet-ai.github.io/ask-kit/, is it visible at a desktop width, and what kind of element holds it?
At a 390 px phone width, does https://temet-ai.github.io/ask-kit/ scroll sideways, and which image has no width and height set?
On https://temet-ai.github.io/ask-kit/ click the "Reads only" filter. Which kit is left on the page?
Check https://temet.ai/ at a desktop width for colour pairs that are hard to tell apart with red-green colour blindness. Give the colours and which simulation makes them close.
Take a screenshot of https://temet-ai.github.io/ask-kit/ at 390 px wide and give me the file path.
